newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continueing its rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continueing its rally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to continue their rally on Sunday amid selective buying, brokers said.
"We expect an upward market trend as the investors may buy select blue chips having good track records even if they are expensive," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
Brokers said scrips in engineering, food and financial sectors might move further.
The DSE benchmarck index closed 28.37 points or 1.81 percent up at 1,591.03 on Saturday. Friday is weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
